narrative_purpose: Hero thumbnail: captures the essence of the chapter — the Metkayina living atop and within a living biogenic reef.
subject: A panoramic twilight view of the Metkayina settlement at Awa'atlu. Organic woven pod-dwellings (marui) hang suspended from the arched aerial roots of giant water-borne mangrove-like trees. Beneath them, calm glowing turquoise lagoon water laps against cascading terraced limestone seawall rim-pools extending into the open sea under a dusk sky with the giant banded form of Polyphemus rising.
scene: A peaceful coastal reef lagoon at dusk, soft bioluminescent glows along the reef crest and dwelling interiors.
camera: Wide cinematic 16:9 establishing vista at water level.
light: Deep indigo twilight sky, soft amber interior light in dwellings, bioluminescent cyan and teal along the living reef edges.
palette: Ocean teal, void indigo, bioluminescent cyan, warm amber dwelling accents.
style: Painterly naturalist landscape, atmospheric and grand.
detail_level: Rich on the living root architecture, terraced reef walls, and water reflections.
composition: Stepped reef terraces sweeping across the lower midground, suspended pods in upper right, calm lagoon center-left.
consistency_notes: Follow canonical Metkayina village architecture from Way of Water. The reef is clearly biological and stepped.
